criteria.description: The runtime-home guard fails on a bare `.spec-kitty` literal in src/specify_cli/status/locking.py, and that module is not on _HOME_LITERAL_ALLOWLIST.
criteria.proof_type: pytest tests/audit/test_no_legacy_path_literals.py (9 passed); red replayed in commit 8585b377b2, which failed naming src/specify_cli/status/locking.py:65

criteria.description: src/specify_cli/status/locking.py derives its repository-local lock directory name from specify_cli.paths.RUNTIME_STATE_DIR_NAME, not from a literal typed in the module.

criteria.description: The status-lock fallback constant no longer presents itself as a home (the `_NON_GIT_LOCK_HOME` symbol is gone; the value is a repository-local directory).

criteria.description: The bare non-git status lock still resolves to <repo_root>/.spec-kitty/spec-kitty-locks/<key>.status.lock and mints neither a .git nor a .kittify marker.
An allowlist-bypassed scan of the global-state surface reports no src/specify_cli/status/locking.py violation, so the #6582 exemption cannot be re-added silently.
